description: A React component named DetailsViewer that renders detailed views of data objects, supporting features like collapsible sections, raw JSON toggle, formatted fields, and agent-specific interactions.

methods.name: safePretty
methods.description: Returns a JSON string of the payload with fallback to string conversion or error message.

methods.name: toLabel
methods.description: Formats a key into a user-friendly label using formatLabel utility.

methods.name: isTimestampLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a timestamp or date field.

methods.name: isTokenLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles token count fields.

methods.name: isDurationLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles duration or latency fields.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a numeric value into a human-readable duration string.

methods.name: isCurrencyKeyLoose
methods.description: Determines if a key likely represents a currency or cost field.

methods.name: formatValueByKey
methods.description: Formats a value based on its key, applying special formatting for currency, tokens, timestamps, or durations.

methods.name: initialCollapsed
methods.description: Determines if a section should be collapsed based on depth and collapsedDepth.

methods.name: Collapser
methods.description: A React component that renders a collapsible section with toggle button.

methods.name: renderPrimitiveVal
methods.description: Renders a primitive value with formatting and styling.

methods.name: extractAgentIdentity
methods.description: Extracts agent id and name from an object if available.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Recursively renders data nodes, handling arrays, objects, and primitives with collapsible sections.

methods.name: renderEntries
methods.description: Renders key-value entries of an object, ordering highlighted keys first.
